model.display_name: LungAI DenseNet-121 — Six-Class Chest X-Ray Classifier
model.architecture: DenseNet-121 backbone + GAP + BatchNorm + Dense(256, ReLU) + Dropout(0.3) + Dense(6, softmax)
model.pretrained_weights: imagenet (Keras Applications release weights, downloaded by Keras on first build)

checkpoint.selection: chosen over run 1 by the pre-registered rule in docs/data/run_selection_protocol.md (artifacts/evaluation_reports/run_comparison.json)
checkpoint.availability: NOT IN REPOSITORY (*.h5 is gitignored; 28.7 MB). Install with scripts/install_checkpoint.py into models/ (or set MODELS_DIR). The backend refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs unless LUNGAI_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_CHECKPOINT=true.

historical_checkpoints.status: superseded by v6.1 on 2026-11-03 (run comparison); file in runs/v6_densenet121_seed42/model.h5, evaluation in artifacts/evaluation_reports/v6_*
lost (not in repository; SHA-256 recorded in docs/archive/historical_audits/END_TO_END_APPLICATION_TEST_REPORT.md)

preprocessing.decode: cv2.imdecode/imread with IMREAD_COLOR (grayscale is replicated to 3 channels; alpha dropped)
preprocessing.note: Filters run at native resolution before resizing (historical order, kept for train/serve parity with the recorded checkpoint). See docs/limitations.md.

training.class_weighting: balanced: n_train / (n_classes * n_train_class), applied as per-sample weights

checkpoint_selection.historical_note: The recorded v5.0 checkpoint was the final epoch of phase 2; validation was evaluated once after training and its value was not saved.

test.permitted_use: Report once; never tune on it

external.permitted_use: Report once; never train or select on it

dataset.note: Built from official sources by scripts/data/build_v6_manifest.py; the build folder is gitignored (raw images are not redistributable).

test.permitted_use: Report once; never tune on it

dataset_v5_historical.data_root_note: Manifest image paths are relative to the data root (the folder that contains data/raw and data/downloads).

external_cohort.name: Montgomery County CXR (NLM)
external_cohort.purpose: Independent external assessment; never used for training or model selection
external_cohort.task: binary abnormality (predicted class != Normal) and exact Tuberculosis recall; NOT a six-class evaluation

evaluation.roc_auc_definition: one-vs-rest per class; macro = unweighted mean over the 6 classes (sklearn roc_auc_score multi_class='ovr', average='macro')

inference.confidence_floor_note: Top-class softmax below this is reported as inconclusive. Not clinically validated; softmax is uncalibrated.

cxr_gate.heuristic_threshold_source: scripts/data/calibrate_cxr_gate.py on v6_build_002 validation radiographs (artifacts/app_checks/cxr_gate_calibration_v6_build_002.json): lowest threshold that still rejects every available non-radiograph test image (highest stage-1-passing negative 0.692 + 0.01); passes 91.0% of validation radiographs (38.7% at 0.83). The negatives are synthetic, so rejection of real non-radiographs is not established.
